answer: Because the rationale is hashed into the wander record and indexed in the signal history, the marble audit keeps the original text and a copied rationale is provable. Every submission carries a rationale field that must mention at least 4 distinct ledger facts, and a rationale that merely restates the answer is rejected as a duplicate of its own body. Filling 46 aliases therefore needs 46 separate readings of the chain, which is research work rather than text generation. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
